assembly_human_review: root-webgl-reviewed; user overall art acceptance pending
source_mode: original generated 2D concept to local TripoSR single-image reconstruction
style: original human kingdom; detailed stylized medieval steel, deep royal blue cloth, warm brass sun emblem, worn leather
preprocess: RGBA alpha-bounds crop, Lanczos fit to 85% of a 512 square, alpha composite against RGB(127,127,127); no rembg
isolation: Windows uv CPython 3.11 venv and source/weights cache under C:/Users/bag57/.cache/codex-rts3d
pipeline_difference: PyMCubes 0.1.6 (BSD-3-Clause) CPU marching cubes replaces uncompiled torchmcubes CUDA/CPU extension; its compiled extension is loaded directly to avoid scipy-only smoothing helpers; network inference and density/color queries remain on PyTorch CUDA

v2_trial.method: same input and TripoSR model; one mild mesh smoothing step, all smooth normals, xatlas UV and 2048 per-texel GPU neural-color query with sRGB baseColor texture
v2_trial.visual_review: Smoothing and color pipeline improved, but source ornament remains blurry, rear is hallucinated, and 64px guard identity is insufficient

v3_body_trial.method: front and rear original 1024x1536 RGBA image projection onto unchanged v2 UV mesh, alpha/normal/depth gated and linear-RGB blended with v2 neural side color
v3_body_trial.visual_review: Front and rear armor detail is readable; side remains soft and rear skirt partly distorts; empty-handed 64px render cannot establish equipped guard identity

approval_note: Production-v2 safely merges same-skin/material equipment and passes root actual WebGL team/LOD/five-action review. Previous production-v1 is archived; failed initial v1/v2 neural pilots remain outside runtime.

initial_pilot.approval_note: Technical image-to-3D generation succeeded, but visual QA failed the detailed medieval guard target. No candidate is approved or published by this contract.

production_v2.visual_tolerance: At most six 8-bit channel samples per frame differ by one level; ten checked frames
